name: LinkedIn Profile Lookup (via Apify)

description: Fetch a LinkedIn profile's full details — title, work history, education, contact info when available. Use for researching a specific person. NOT for their posts (use linkedin_profile_posts) or for searching employees (use linkedin_company_employees).
